what: Editorial classification for refs/MANIFEST.md. The COUNTS, kit coverage, material roles and done-markers are all derived from live sources by scripts/gen_manifest.py; only the judgement calls live here, so they are reviewable in one place instead of buried in prose.
why_a_data_file: The operator ruled MANIFEST.md is regenerated from the recipes and never hand-edited. Classification is a judgement a script cannot make, so it is DECLARED here rather than typed into the output. Editing this file and re-running the generator is the supported path; editing MANIFEST.md is not.
prose_key_rule: No key here begins with an underscore. This file is DATA and scripts read it; the repo rule that scripts must not read prose keys stays satisfied because there are none.

church.note: Focal anchor of both concepts. Ratio-scored against the chalet silhouette.

wood_stack.note: Most repeated object in concept 02; what makes the place read as inhabited.

cart.height_basis: DERIVED from the crossed kit wheel, not proposed. SM_WoodenWheelA measures 87.2 x 87.3 cm across the disc (consistent to 0.1%), so the axle sits at 43.6 cm and 87.2 cm is a HARD FLOOR for any cart carrying it. The body above the wheel top is the one modelling assumption: a low-sided cart adds roughly a quarter of the wheel diameter. 87.2 is measured; the step to 110.0 is declared and is the part to check against the first frame.
cart.view_spec: 4 views az 000/035/090/180 at 1280. Long-and-low like the wood stack, so the 800 px per-image floor binds on WIDTH; the set ruling covers rotations but shoot at 1280 to keep the master comfortable.
cart.note: Concept 02 only, count 1, left frame edge, painted red detail.

crate.height_basis: PROPOSED, not measured. Knee-to-thigh against the 176.0 cm character capsule; single crates stay under the 45 cm max step height. Nothing on disk gives a crate dimension.
crate.view_spec: 4 views az 000/035/090/180 at 1024. Near-equidimensional, so the 80-90% fill band applies cleanly -- the easy subject for the spec.

chalet.note: 31 unique measured meshes stand and render (33 rows, two duplicated). Look is plaster; concepts say stone + timber. A material problem, not geometry.

chalet_large.note: The two framing buildings of concept 02. Closest, most legible architecture in either concept -- they set the material bar.

stone_arch.note: A declared PLACEMENT in concept 02, not clutter -- architecture the concept names, so it outranks the clutter rows despite appearing once. Outcrop* and Construction_Pieces are candidates; the gap report says not confirmed by eye and neither is crossed.

lantern.note: SM_LanternPost is crossed. The concept says WALL-MOUNTED and LIT; the crossed asset is a POST. Geometry servable, mounting and emissive are authoring.

river_stone.note: rock_scatter.py is built and proven with a talus field, and recipes/alpine_8k.json declares NO rock species -- the list is empty while recipes/alpine.json declares ten. A declaration gap, cheap to close.

wildflower.note: The grass system carries varieties; no flower asset is declared.

track.note: Recorded in DIFFERENT sections -- clutter in 01, terrain in 02 -- so a naive per-section count reports it as two things appearing once each. 838 street slabs placed; needs continuous-surface re-emission plus a dirt/cobble material.

stream.note: WATER IS A SYSTEM, NOT AN ASSET, and takes no forge slot (ruled). No water in any recipe, no shoreline handling, no landscape-material or navmesh interaction. Concept 01 builds without it; concept 02 cannot be fully matched.

peak.note: Terrain, not a mesh. The same peak in both concepts -- once both cameras are solved the village-to-peak vector must agree, which is the concepts' own cross-check.

rock_wall.note: CC0 from polyhaven.com, byte-identical to the .fbm copy. NOT legally blocked -- the restriction belongs to the donor mesh, not the third-party textures bundled beside it. Every chalet in both concepts has a masonry ground floor, plus the church base.

floor_worn.note: CC0 from polyhaven.com, byte-identical to the .fbm copy.

copper_patina.note: The operator is generating this. Until it lands, a PIPELINE-DERIVED placeholder from an existing base is permitted and must never become the artefact of record. Concept 02's single most specific material call: WEATHERED COPPER ONION DOME, dark red-brown, with a finial.

removed.barrel: Not declared in EITHER concept -- the string does not occur in alpine_village_01.json or _02.json. It came from the gap report's prose 'Crates / barrels'. Removed by ruling 2026-08-30; cross the pack asset if it is ever wanted.
